title: Negative tests
summary: A negative test checks how a program rejects an invalid input. The expected result may be a useful error instead of a normal value.
introduction: A negative test checks how a program rejects an invalid input. The expected result may be a useful error instead of a normal value. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A negative test checks how a program rejects an invalid input. The expected result may be a useful error instead of a normal value.

blocks.title: Negative tests

blocks.text: The output explains that a negative side is not allowed. Rejecting it is the expected behaviour.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Test side zero and explain why it is a different case.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not call an expected rejection a failing test.
For more detail later, use this [Software Testing further reading](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Testing).
